lines.text: [steady] Day seven. We didn't leave each other's side.
[warm] Coffee. The café. His laugh. Like there was no tomorrow.
[low] Then the rain came. At eleven, his phone buzzed. Arjun's number.
[shaking] It's... a voice note. From me.
[calm, sad] If she's with you on the bridge, she lives. If she isn't... you do. Choose her.
[gentle, firm] Whatever happens... don't let go.
[fast, breathless] Eleven ten. The bridge. Headlights out of the rain.
lines.show: 11:10. The bridge. Headlights out of the rain.

lines.text: [whisper] He pushed me back. Just like the first time.
[barely a whisper, disbelief] Then... his watch started ticking.
